links.outcome: AI AUC and calibration on external Japanese cohort versus development dataset
links.effect: GliomaDepth-IDH declined to AUC 0.75 and GliomaVista-IDH to 0.82 on the Japanese cohort; GliomaVista-IDH Brier score 0.32 (vs 0.97 AUC on BraTS).
links.quote: However, external validation on a Japanese cohort revealed performance degradation: GliomaDepth-IDH declined to an AUC of 0.75 and GliomaVista-IDH to 0.82, with GliomaVista-IDH showing significant calibration issues (Brier score = 0.32).

screen.reason: This study compares the diagnostic performance of two AI imaging models against 18 physicians across multiple reader groups, including external validation testing calibration degradation, but it does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
